title: Rav Anan bar Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Midrash Tehillim 65:4 for Rabbi Berechyah, Rabbi Chilkiyah and Rav Anan bar Yosef in the name of Rabbi (Idi).
Hyman also cites the Shuvah section of Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, where Rabbi Berechyah reports Rabbi Anan, son of Rabbi Yose. See the entry Rav Chanan bar Yosef.

notes.text: The consulted Midrash Tehillim 65:4 reads Rabbi Berechyah, Rabbi Chelbo and Rav Anan bar Yosef in the name of Rav Idi. Hyman gives Chilkiyah and Rabbi (Idi).
